sys_script_include.description: Server-side helper for the unauthenticated Experience Portal. Provides submitCase(payload) for anonymous case submission and lookupCase(number) for anonymous status lookup. Enforces strict field whitelisting per AAP Section 0.7.4: submission accepts only subject, type, description, requester_name, requester_email and forces status=Draft regardless of payload; lookup returns only status, subject, opened_date and never exposes internal fields. submitCase validates its input before inserting - subject, description and requester_name are required and must not exceed 255/4000/100 characters (an over-length value is refused with a named field error, never truncated), requester_email must look like an address when supplied and must not exceed 100 characters, type must be a live choice of x_casemgmt_case.type - and a coarse flood guard bounds the unauthenticated write path; submitCase returns {number} on success, {error, fields} when validation refuses the payload, {error, throttled} when the flood guard refuses it, or {error} when the insert fails; lookupCase returns the whitelisted record on match or null on no-match (the calling scripted REST endpoint translates null into the HTTP 404 not-found response whose verbatim body is specified by AAP Section 0.7.4). Replaces the persistence and lookup roles of ArkCase SaveCaseService and GetCaseByNumberService for the portal slice. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint and zero hardcoded sys_id reference literals.
sys_script_include.name: CasePortalService
